title: Create a multi-panel storyboard (e.g., 49 panels), cut it into a film-strip…
content: Create a multi-panel storyboard (e.g., 49 panels), cut it into a film-strip layout, and upload that film strip as a video reference in Seedance to guide shot progression.
tips: Create a multi-panel storyboard (e.g., 49 panels), cut it into a film-strip layout, and upload that film strip as a video reference in Seedance to guide shot progression.

es.content:
Crea un storyboard de varios paneles (por ejemplo, 49 paneles), córtalo en un diseño de tira de película y sube esa tira de película como referencia de video en Seedance para guiar la progresión de las tomas.
